name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport began in childhood, captivated by the roar of engines at Interlagos. He pursued electrical engineering, always with the goal of working in racing. After graduating from the Universidade de São Paulo, he honed his skills in automotive electronics before landing a role with a Brazilian stock car team. His meticulous approach to data analysis and rapid problem-solving quickly earned him recognition. 

Rafael joined Stake Sauber three years ago, drawn by the challenge of Formula 1. He thrives on the high-pressure environment, meticulously analyzing sensor data to optimize car performance. His colleagues know him as a demanding but fair leader, always pushing for improvement. His calm demeanor under pressure has proven invaluable during crucial race moments, allowing him to quickly diagnose and resolve electrical issues.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael is a lean man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with electrical diagrams.
Insists on a specific brand of Brazilian coffee before every race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when analyzing data, a trait that both amuses and annoys his colleagues.
